event.title: Microsoft Restores Services After Major Global Outage
event.canonical_title: Microsoft Restores Services After Major Global Outage
event.summary: Microsoft is actively working to restore services, including Outlook and Teams, following a global outage that has affected users worldwide. Many workers have taken to social media to share humorous takes on the disruption, which has left some without access to email and other tools.

timeline.title: Microsoft Restores Services After Major Global Outage
timeline.summary: Microsoft has announced that services across Teams, Outlook, and other products have been fully restored following a global outage that lasted over 24 hours. The disruption impacted various sectors, including governments, healthcare, and businesses worldwide. Microsoft has ruled out a cyberattack as the cause of the outage.
key_facts: Microsoft services were down for over 24 hours.
The outage affected Teams, Outlook, and other Microsoft products.
Governments and businesses worldwide reported disruptions.
Microsoft ruled out a cyberattack as the cause.
